prova:
refine ⟨∅, ?_, ?_⟩
  ·
    haveI : Classical.Verm := inferInstance
    have h1 : (G.induce (∅ : Set V)).vertices = (∅ : Set V) := by
      rw [SimpleGraph.induce]
      simp
    rw [h1]
    simp only [SimpleGraph.chromaticNumber_empty, coe_nat]
    omega
  ·
    haveI : Classical.Verm := inferInstance
    have h2 : (∅ : Set V)ᶜ = Set.univ := by simp
    rw [h2]
    have h3 : (G.induce Set.univ).vertices = G.vertices := by
      rw [SimpleGraph.induce]
      simp
    rw [h3]
    simp only [SimpleGraph.chromaticNumber, coe_nat]
    simpa using hG_chrom
